action.rationale: With dim=20 and only 100 evals (< 30·dim=600) plus noisy observations, model-based methods are most sample-efficient early. We lack landscape info, so a small race between TuRBO and GP-BO (20% of budget) will pick the better performer before spending the remaining ~80 evals.

In 20D with a tight budget (80 evals left < 20·dim) and noisy objectives, the race showed gp_bo slightly better (618,561 vs 625,966) and it hasn’t run any tenure evals yet (evals_in_tenure=0). Let gp_bo leverage its initial model; we’ll reassess if progress stalls.
